scope: search_knowledge lexical fallback (BI-MCP-EFF-4F823E5B). apps/web/lib/inference/semantic-memory.ts matches the [ai-context] persistent-surface rule, but no stored surface changes. A new read-only function, searchPlatformKnowledgeLexical, term-matches the existing title and contentPreview payload fields of the platform-knowledge collection via a new read-only searchLexical in packages/db/src/pgvector-store.ts. searchPlatformKnowledge gains an optional query-time embed deadline. The vector_embedding table, its payloads, every stored vector, the write path, the embedding model and the similarity threshold are untouched. No asset, field, policy, retention or lifecycle change occurred.
approver: platform-architecture (autonomous; operator-directed delivery of epic EP-0237A305 item BI-MCP-EFF-4F823E5B)
rationale: A DataImpactManifest would have to fabricate change kinds for a stored surface whose shape did not move. The change adds one read over payload fields already projected into AI context by searchPlatformKnowledge, under the same tool and the same registry_read grant. This is the same class of change already excepted for this surface in changes/search-knowledge-availability-status.data-impact-exception.json and changes/mcp-efficiency-refusal-ledger.data-impact-exception.json.
compensatingControl: packages/db/src/pgvector-store.test.ts asserts the lexical SQL is parameterised and escapes LIKE wildcards. apps/web/lib/inference/semantic-memory-availability.test.ts asserts the lexical path never embeds and reports unavailable when its own query fails. apps/web/lib/mcp/packs/knowledge-pack.test.ts asserts lexical results are labelled lexical-fallback and that an empty lexical result is not reported as a clean miss. Callers that threshold on cosine scores (backlog-ingest duplicate detection, epic overlap) still call searchPlatformKnowledge only.
